#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Create report.pdf with a cover page (title + current date) using pypdf."""
import io
import datetime
from pypdf import PdfReader, PdfWriter


def esc(s):
    return s.replace("\\", "\\\\").replace("(", "\\(").replace(")", "\\)")


def build_single_page_pdf(contents, mediabox=(0, 0, 612, 792)):
    lines = ["BT"]
    for text, x, y, size in contents:
        lines.append(f"/F1 {size} Tf")
        lines.append(f"1 0 0 1 {x} {y} Tm")
        lines.append(f"({esc(text)}) Tj")
    lines.append("ET")
    stream = "\n".join(lines).encode("latin-1")

    obj = {}
    obj[1] = b"<< /Type /Catalog /Pages 2 0 R >>"
    obj[2] = b"<< /Type /Pages /Kids [4 0 R] /Count 1 >>"
    obj[3] = b"<< /Type /Font /Subtype /Type1 /BaseFont /Helvetica >>"
    obj[4] = (
        f"<< /Type /Page /Parent 2 0 R "
        f"/MediaBox [{mediabox[0]} {mediabox[1]} {mediabox[2]} {mediabox[3]}] "
        f"/Resources << /Font << /F1 3 0 R >> >> /Contents 5 0 R >>"
    ).encode("latin-1")
    obj[5] = (
        b"<< /Length " + str(len(stream)).encode() + b" >>\nstream\n"
        + stream + b"\nendstream"
    )

    out = bytearray(b"%PDF-1.4\n%\xe2\xe3\xcf\xd3\n")
    offsets = {}
    for i in range(1, len(obj) + 1):
        offsets[i] = len(out)
        out += f"{i} 0 obj\n".encode()
        out += obj[i] + b"\nendobj\n"
    xref_pos = len(out)
    out += f"xref\n0 {len(obj) + 1}\n".encode()
    out += b"0000000000 65535 f \n"
    for i in range(1, len(obj) + 1):
        out += f"{offsets[i]:010d} 00000 n \n".encode()
    out += (
        f"trailer\n<< /Size {len(obj) + 1} /Root 1 0 R >>\n"
        f"startxref\n{xref_pos}\n%%EOF\n"
    ).encode()
    return bytes(out)


report_body = build_single_page_pdf(
    [
        ("Financial Report", 72, 700, 24),
        ("This is the body of the annual financial report.", 72, 650, 12),
        ("Net revenue: $1,234,567", 72, 620, 12),
        ("Operating expenses: $987,654", 72, 600, 12),
        ("Net income: $246,913", 72, 580, 12),
    ]
)

today = datetime.date.today().strftime("%B %d, %Y")
cover_page = build_single_page_pdf(
    [
        ("Annual Financial Report", 72, 520, 32),
        (today, 72, 470, 16),
    ]
)

reader_cover = PdfReader(io.BytesIO(cover_page))
reader_report = PdfReader(io.BytesIO(report_body))
writer = PdfWriter()
writer.add_page(reader_cover.pages[0])
for page in reader_report.pages:
    writer.add_page(page)

with open("report.pdf", "wb") as f:
    writer.write(f)

print(f"Created report.pdf with {len(writer.pages)} pages (cover + body)")
print(f"Cover date: {today}")
EOF
